features.feature_summary: Enables Gemini Code Assist chat to handle complex multi-step tasks with planned, reviewable changes before modifications are made.
features.extended_definition: Enables Gemini Code Assist chat to handle complex multi-step tasks with planned, reviewable changes before modifications are made.

features.feature_summary: Lets Gemini Code Assist agent mode analyze an entire project to produce more context-aware completions, suggestions, and refactorings.
features.extended_definition: Lets Gemini Code Assist agent mode analyze an entire project to produce more context-aware completions, suggestions, and refactorings.

features.feature_summary: Allows Gemini Code Assist agent mode to make concurrent changes across multiple files in a codebase from a single prompt.
features.extended_definition: Allows Gemini Code Assist agent mode to make concurrent changes across multiple files in a codebase from a single prompt.

features.feature_summary: Lets Gemini Code Assist access external services from the IDE.
features.extended_definition: Lets Gemini Code Assist access external services from the IDE.
